page.title: Ironman Marbella 2040: Post-Race Recovery Boat Charter Tips

data.meta_description: Ironman Marbella 2040 recovery charter: post-race boat hire in Puerto Banús with spa-level comfort, cold drinks, and sea views. Book your recovery cruise now.
data.summary: Expert tips for post-Ironman recovery on a boat charter in Marbella. Relax muscles, hydrate, and celebrate with a private cruise from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How soon after Ironman Marbella should I charter a boat?
faq.a: Most athletes charter the same evening or the next morning. Your muscles benefit from gentle movement and cold drinks in a relaxed setting. We recommend a 2-hour cruise for a quick recovery session, or a half-day trip to combine rest with light sightseeing along the coast.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a small recovery group?
faq.a: For up to 5 people, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are compact and cost-effective. For up to 11 pax, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offers ample deck space and shade. All include drinks and snacks.

faq.q: Can I bring my own recovery gear on board?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring foam rollers, resistance bands, or a yoga mat. The deck areas on boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) provide enough space for gentle stretching. Just avoid heavy weights or bulky equipment.

faq.q: What drinks are included in the charter?
faq.a: Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For post-race recovery, we recommend hydrating with water and electrolytes. The crew can serve you chilled drinks as soon as you step aboard.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age for passengers?
faq.a: There is no minimum age, but children must be supervised at all times. Life jackets are available for all sizes. The gentle cruise is suitable for families celebrating an athlete's finish.

faq.q: Can I book a charter for the same day as the race?
faq.a: Yes, same-day bookings are possible via WhatsApp if availability allows. Many athletes book in advance to secure their preferred time slot. Evening departures from Puerto Banús are popular for post-race celebrations.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for recovery charters?
faq.a: Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, we can reschedule subject to availability. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable. Check our terms at booking.

faq.q: Do you offer any special recovery packages for Ironman participants?
faq.a: We don't have a fixed package, but you can customise your charter with extra snacks, non-alcoholic drinks, or a longer duration. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your needs. The Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski for additional fun.

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2040 is a monumental achievement. Your body has pushed through 3.8 km of swimming, 180 km of cycling, and a full marathon. Now, recovery is your priority. A post-race boat charter from Puerto Banús offers the perfect environment: gentle sea breeze, cold hydration, and zero impact on sore muscles. Whether you choose a 2-hour cruise on the Astondoa 40 (€749) or a half-day on the Mangusta 80 (€4,719), you'll reward yourself with comfort, shade, and stunning views of the Costa del Sol. Here's how to plan the ultimate recovery charter.

Why a boat charter aids Ironman recovery

After 226 km of exertion, your muscles need low-impact movement and cooling. A boat provides a floating recovery zone: you can stretch on deck, soak in the sun (or shade), and hydrate without walking or standing for long periods. The gentle rocking of the boat helps reduce muscle stiffness. Plus, the sea air is rich in negative ions, which can improve mood and oxygen uptake. All our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava — but for recovery, we recommend starting with water and electrolytes.

Best boats for post-race relaxation

For small groups of up to 5 athletes, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are ideal — compact, affordable, and easy to board. For larger teams of up to 11, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, €749/2h) offers a spacious flybridge and salon. If you want to celebrate with a splash, the Mangusta 80 (24m, from €4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the race finish line. Check our full fleet at [Boat Rental Marbella](/).

What to bring for an optimal recovery cruise

Pack light: a towel, swimwear (if you fancy a gentle dip), sunscreen, and a change of clothes. Foam rollers and resistance bands are welcome on deck. Avoid heavy gear. The crew will provide chilled towels and serve drinks. If you need ice packs, let us know when you book via WhatsApp. The key is to keep movement easy — no gym workouts, just passive recovery with a view of La Concha mountain.

Best routes and stops for recovery

A typical 2-hour recovery cruise heads west along the Golden Mile, past the Marbella Marina and towards Cabopino. You'll see the dunes and pine forests from the water. For a longer 4-hour charter, continue to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés — quiet coves where you can anchor and swim in calm, clear water. The gentle sea state in summer (water temperature 22-26°C) is perfect for a short, non-strenuous swim. Avoid choppy open water; your body doesn't need more pounding.

Nutrition and hydration on board

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts). For serious recovery, we recommend supplementing with electrolyte tablets (bring your own) and protein-rich snacks. The crew can store your cool bag in the fridge. Avoid excessive alcohol immediately after the race — save the cava toast for later. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) has a large fridge and wet bar for custom setups.

Booking tips for Ironman week

Book early — Ironman weekend is busy. Slots fill by March. Use WhatsApp for real-time availability. For groups of 10-12, the Mangusta 80 (Grey) or Ferretti 94 (29m) offer luxury space. Prices for our Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. Departs from Puerto Banús, with easy parking and taxi access. Combine your recovery charter with a sunset cruise for the full Marbella experience. See all options at [Boat Rental Marbella](/).
